csv_project_name: DB for Outdoor Water Recreation Facility
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Liberal is seeking qualified water recreation and aquatics facility consulting firms to provide planning, design, and construction services for the development of a new outdoor water recreation facility in Liberal, Kansas. The goal of this facility is to create an enjoyable aquatic experience for all residents and ages. We envision the creation of an outdoor water recreation facility which integrates an unstaffed, openly accessible, large-scale splash park with an adjacent paid-access, seasonally staffed facility featuring a lazy river and water park amenities suitable for all ages. The location of this project will replace an existing facility Adventure Bay Family Water Park at the intersection of N. Kansas Avenue and W. 11th Street inside Light Park. The current footprint of the water park facility is approximately 95,160 square feet. Parking infrastructure surrounds the current facility and will not need to be incorporated into facility design plans.
